description: Synthetic #70 cases for real PostgreSQL tests; identities and text are not private data.
expected: deleting the first note redacts only its citation; the Markdown citation retains its excerpt and revision-bound range
replaying the finalized answer after redaction returns the current redacted citation, never the original excerpt
explicit retry of a cancelled attempt keeps its incomplete message and creates a new attempt linked to the same input IDs
late completion of a cancelled attempt cannot mark it completed
an input accepted while an answer runs is queued with a distinct identity and survives reconnect
failed output remains incomplete and no-support remains distinct from a completed sourced answer
a repeated create request cannot restore a conversation deleted after its first creation
